a.text: Juno, welcome to Lowmarket.  I need you to go to a place called the Sable Noodle House. An Echo broker's dead and his implant is fried.

a2.text: Looks like a burnout. Just sign off on what you find and go home. Don't make this into more than it is.

b.text: Yeah, I copy. Sorry, chief, I'm a little out of it.  I think I lost another hour on that train.

c.text: Everybody loses an hour on Line 9, Juno. Just get it done.  Hale, out.
